events.name: Bash
events.head: Survey check files, test key names, recent commits and decision log
events.input: $ wc -l cloud/src/connectors/CHECKS.md cloud/scripts/connector-checks.mjs cloud/scripts/probe-connector-guards.mjs && cat cloud/src/connectors/CHECKS.md | cut -c1-400 && echo ---KEYS && (sed 's/=.*/=<set>/' ~/.config/tantra/keys/vendor-test.env 2>/dev/null) && echo ---GIT && git log --oneline -5 -- cloud/src/connectors cloud/scripts/connector-checks.mjs && git status --short cloud/src/connectors cloud/scripts scripts/walkthroughs | head -20 && echo ---CHK && grep -n -i "ghl\|gohighlevel\|hubspot\|zoho\|whatsapp" cloud/scripts/connector-checks.mjs | head -30 && echo ---DEC && grep -n "O-a41e6a8

events.name: Bash
events.head: Show the rest of the survey output, trimmed

events.name: Bash
events.head: List runnable checks, script structure, CRM connector functions and key file names
events.input: $ node cloud/scripts/connector-checks.mjs 2>&1 | cut -c1-220 | head -30; echo ---STRUCT; grep -n "^const \|^async function \|^function \|^  [a-z]*: {\|^  [a-z]*:" cloud/scripts/connector-checks.mjs | cut -c1-200 | head -70; echo ---CRM; grep -n "export .*\(ghl\|hs\|hub\|zoho\|crm\)" -i cloud/src/connectors/stack.ts | cut -c1-230; echo ---TKEY; grep -l -i "TANTRA.*API_KEY\|tnt_\|TANTRA_TEST" ~/.config/tantra/keys/* ~/.config/tantra/*.json 2>/dev/null | head; ls ~/.config/tantra/keys/ | head -30; echo ---GUARD; grep -n -i "ghl\|hubspot\|zoho" cloud/scripts/probe-connector-guards.mjs | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read the check script header, helpers and the Stripe check for idiom
events.input: $ sed -n 1,60p cloud/scripts/connector-checks.mjs | cut -c1-260; sed -n 266,327p cloud/scripts/connector-checks.mjs | cut -c1-330

events.name: Bash
events.head: Run the Zoom check and show script header, registry, ledger tail
events.input: $ node cloud/scripts/connector-checks.mjs zoom --go 2>&1 | cut -c1-400 | tail -15; echo ---; sed -n 1,30p cloud/scripts/connector-checks.mjs | cut -c1-260; echo ---; sed -n 296,327p cloud/scripts/connector-checks.mjs | cut -c1-300; echo ---; tail -4 scripts/walkthroughs/REVERT_LEDGER.md | cut -c1-400; grep -n "WhatsApp" cloud/src/connectors/CHECKS.md | cut -c1-200; grep -n "zoho\|hubspot\|ghl" cloud/scripts/probe-connector-guards.mjs | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check the http helper, key loading, and the two CHECKS.md rows to update
events.input: $ grep -n "^async function http" -A14 cloud/scripts/connector-checks.mjs | cut -c1-220; grep -n "const which\|const fileKeys" -A3 cloud/scripts/connector-checks.mjs | cut -c1-200 | head -12; grep -n "GoHighLevel, HubSpot, Zoho\|event subscription" cloud/src/connectors/CHECKS.md | cut -c1-500
